answer:
I rebuilt the page on your Lisbon packing note for VoiceOver, and it can now add items. I haven't tested it with VoiceOver or in the app.

**Accessibility**
- Every item is a real checkbox with its name as the label. VoiceOver reads "T-shirts x4, checkbox, not checked", and packed state doesn't depend on color or strike-through.
- Each section (Clothes, Documents, Tech) has a heading, so your partner can jump between them. Each heading also says how many items are packed, and a summary line gives the total, for example "1 of 9 items packed".
- Focus stays on the checkbox you just toggled.
- The add form has labeled fields, a Section picker and an Add item button. Results and errors are announced.
- Targets are at least 44 px, focus outlines are visible, and contrast is higher in light and dark mode.

**Adding items**
Pages can't add checklist lines, so I added a small "Added items" table at the bottom of the note with Category, Item and Packed columns. New items go there and show up under their section on the page, with the same checkboxes. Your original checklists are unchanged.

The page is under Page in the note.
